title: DateField props
description: A DateField item's props (FR-13, atoms design decision 1): a label of 1 to 200 characters, an optional description of 1 to 1000 and optional min and max, the Gantt's full-dates. That the days exist within the Gantt's days and that max is not before min are checks of dateFieldPropsProblems. In the input format since atoms.
